flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/index.tsx and pages/Report/action/ActionReport.tsx (placeholder entries without path/resource); ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (OCMS_REPORT_* mappings without a court application report). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code
note: Status Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: SFTP, code split, SFTP permission granted to the api App Service server. The story asks OCMS to produce a summary report of processed rejected records and any processing errors. Since there is no return-file processing (see OCMS24.17), there is no report. The UI entries 'Court Application Vault Reports' and 'Court Application Submit Reports' are placeholders only: empty path and commented-out resource. The OCMS_REPORT_* mappings in api-authorization.properties have no court application report. The sheet status 'Demo paid' is not supported by code in these repos; it may exist outside the six repos (cannot verify from repo). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code for this story. Do not claim as done; only placeholder UI menu entries exist.

steps.step: OCMS generates a summary report of the rejected records processed successfully
steps.detail: No report generator exists for court rejection results. The existing report jobs (daily_reports, notificationreport, paymentReport, jobreport, unclaimedreport, hstreport) do not touch court applications. With no rejection processing (OCMS24.17) there is no source data for a report.

steps.step: The report includes any processing errors
steps.detail: There is no return-file processing error handling because there is no processing. The generic error reporting that exists (JobExecutionReportJob.java:22) reports other jobs, not court rejections.

steps.step: The officer opens the report to see which records were processed successfully
steps.detail: The menu entries 'Court Application Vault Reports' (index.tsx:61-63) and 'Court Application Submit Reports' (index.tsx:65-67) exist, but path = "" and the courtcasesummary resource is commented out in ActionReport.tsx:36-47. There is no courtcasesummary endpoint in the backend and no OCMS_REPORT_* mapping for it in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties. UI placeholder only, not a feature.
